title: Compliance intake glossary mapper and prioritization heuristic
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Problem: Enterprise customers routinely submit diverse security/compliance asks (SOC2 controls clarifications, ISO evidence requests, HIPAA architecture questions, GDPR/DPA residency constraints, and large vendor questionnaires). The current intake is manual, inconsistent, and slows SLAs. This ticket defines a structured glossary + signal heuristic to normalize incoming asks, auto-suggest priority lanes, and produce a minimal evidence checklist to accelerate routing to Legal, Security, or Sales Engineering.
objectives: Create a canonical glossary that maps common customer language to normalized taxonomy (control families, evidence types, regulatory domains)
Define a weighted prioritization heuristic that maps signals to a triage score and SLA lane
Prototype automated attachments and response templates for low-effort asks (e.g., SOC2 evidence attachments, standard DPA excerpt) to reduce manual work
Add metadata to intake records for routing (jurisdiction, sensitivity, requested SLA, contracting stage, customer tier)
Deliver a concise playbook for Support and AE on using the prioritization outputs and override rules
acceptance_criteria: Canonical glossary created: 40+ mapping rows for key terms (SOC2, ISO controls, HIPAA categories, DPA clauses, common questionnaire items) and published to Confluence
Prioritization heuristic defined and documented: shows input signals, weighting, score bands (0-100) -> lane mapping (Fast Path, Standard, Legal Review, Escalation)
Prototype automation: at least 3 auto-response templates wired to intake types (SOC2 evidence bundle, DPA request acknowledgement, GDPR data residency FAQ)
Console intake UI wireframes that display computed triage score and allow human override with reason
Pilot: 50 real incoming requests processed during a 2-week pilot with a target 30% reduction in time-to-first-response for 'Fast Path' items
out_of_scope: Full LLM-based automated questionnaire completions (future work)
On-prem appliance packaging of compliance evidence (handled by Private team)
Changes to contract terms or legal review outcomes (this ticket only surfaces and routes asks)
proposed_heuristic_summary: Score = weighted sum of signals. Signals: customer_tier (seeded from billing, weight 25), regulatory_severity (HIPAA/GDPR weight 25), contract_stage (pre-sign/renewal weight 10), requested_sla (weight 10), data_sensitivity (PII/PHI weight 20), questionnaire_length (weight 10). Normalize to 0-100. Bands: 0-29 = Fast Path (auto-respond), 30-59 = Standard (PM/Sales Eng), 60-84 = Legal Review, 85-100 = Escalation (CS + Security + Legal)
ui_requirements: Intake form fields: jurisdiction, evidence_requested (free text + taxonomy autocomplete), desired_response_by (date), questionnaire_upload
Computed triage score shown prominently with contribution breakdown
Override control for Support/AE with required reason and tags
Link to templated evidence bundles and Confluence glossary from the intake detail panel
data_and_integration_notes: Connect intake to customer canonical record in CRM to fetch customer_tier and contract_stage
Store normalized taxonomy tags on intake record for downstream analytics
Add lightweight webhook for Legal queue and Security queue with payload including score and top 3 signals
Prototype classification using a small rule set + keyword gloss mapping before investing in ML model
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): Build canonical glossary doc, simple keyword->taxonomy mapper, design wireframes for Console intake panel
Phase 2 (3 weeks): Implement backend scoring service (rule-based), add triage score to intake records, implement 3 auto-response templates
Phase 3 (2 weeks): Pilot with Support/AE on 50 requests, collect feedback and adjust weights
Phase 4 (post-pilot): Iterate: add ML classifier to augment mapping, expand templates, instrument KPIs for SLA compliance
kpis: Time-to-first-response for Fast Path items (target < 24 hours)
% reduction in manual routing actions (target 30% after pilot)
Accuracy of lane mapping when compared to human reviewer (target 85% for Fast Path vs human)
Number of intake records with complete taxonomy tags (target 90%)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-automation leading to incorrect legal outcomes. Mitigation: Conservative thresholds for Legal Review band; require human approval for any answer that includes contractual language
Risk: Ambiguous customer language. Mitigation: Add free-text clarifier question and allow follow-up messages before auto-responding
Risk: Data residency/regulatory nuance missed. Mitigation: Jurisdiction flag triggers mandatory Legal/Compliance review when set to certain regions
